verdict.rationale: Meltano's EL pipeline extracts raw data via Singer taps and relies on dbt for transformation into typed, modeled tables (meltano-docs-6), and incremental replication state is tracked (meltano-docs-20/30), but the evidence never confirms that loaded data automatically lands as typed, deduplicated tables without running a separate dbt transform step — raw loader output (e.g. to a warehouse) is typically JSON/variant until dbt models are built and run. missing for 10: evidence that the loader itself produces typed/deduplicated destination tables out-of-the-box, details on how loaders handle schema typing/dedup before dbt, and independent confirmation that end-state tables are analyst-ready without extra transformation work.
